Ordinary least squares with HC3 robust standard errors

Source: R/hc3_stats.R
fit_ols_hc3.Rd

Fits y ~ X by QR and reports selected coefficients with heteroscedasticity-consistent (HC3) standard errors and t-based p-values (n - k degrees of freedom). Rows with a non-finite y or X are dropped first.

Usage

fit_ols_hc3(X, y, terms = NULL, max_leverage = 0.99)

Arguments

X

Numeric design matrix (include the intercept column yourself).

y

Numeric response, one value per row of X.

terms

Column names of X to report; NULL reports the last column.

max_leverage

Largest leverage accepted. Inf never rejects a fit on leverage.

Value

A data.frame with one row per term: term, beta, se, p, n, max_hat, status.

Details

The fit is not attempted (status = "rank_or_n") when n <= k + 20 or X is rank deficient. When the largest leverage reaches max_leverage the result is NA with status = "high_leverage"; otherwise leverages are capped at 1 - 1e-8. A term whose standard error is zero or not finite gets status = "zero_se".

Examples

set.seed(1)
X <- cbind(`(Intercept)` = 1, age = rnorm(200), dose = rnorm(200))
y <- 0.5 * X[, "dose"] + rnorm(200, sd = 1 + abs(X[, "age"]))
fit_ols_hc3(X, y, terms = c("age", "dose"))
#>   term      beta        se           p   n    max_hat status
#> 1  age 0.2153581 0.2220164 0.333231020 200 0.04744096     ok
#> 2 dose 0.5017496 0.1584040 0.001782137 200 0.04744096     ok
